texts.orig: When limited to sick visits, the correlation coeffi cient between continuity and the percentage of time in clinic improved to 58 (P 01). When limited to sick visits only , postgraduate level of training and academic year were no longer significant predictors of continuity  The effect size of percentage of time in clinic on continuity remained 11%. When limited to WCC visits only , there was no significant correlation between continuity and the percentage of time in clinic.
